Hey Everyone,

Not to long ago I posted that we were working on a league demographics survey for fantasy sports. https://voat.co/v/sports/comments/128302

I thought those of you that participated might be interested in the results. Here's a high-level overview.

  • We had 391 responses with 387 useable data points.
  • Most people played in 2 fantasy football leagues at 33.9% of responses.
  • 66.7% did not play fantasy basketball, but of those that did, most played in 1 league at 21.2%
  • Again 58.7% did not play fantasy baseball, but if they did then they mostly played in one league at 21.7%
  • The average league size was mostly 10 or 12, at 42.1% and 47.3% respectively.
  • People mostly like to play with everyone they know at 44.4% of responses.
  • Most players would make fantasy side challenges at 32.65 of responses.

You can see the full-results here: http://sideprize.com/fantasy-league-demographics-and-behavior-survey/

Thanks for your help!
